description: Daily history of SONIA (Sterling Overnight Index Average), the Bank of England-administered reference rate for unsecured overnight sterling lending, series IUDSOIA. Returns the most recent N days (default 90, max 1825). Data: Bank of England Statistical Interactive Database (bankofengland.co.uk/boeapps/database), no auth required, UK Open Government Licence v3.0.

last_n.description: Number of most recent calendar days to return, counting back from today (default 90, max 1825 = 5 years). This is a daily series.
